positive.source: script C version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Rat = 0.1 + 0.2; state y: Rat = 1 / 3; on start { return; } }
script C version "1.0.0"; fn add1(x: Int) -> Int = x + 1; fn twice(x: Int) -> Int = x * 2; fn calc(x: Int) -> Int = twice(add1(x)); entity E { state x: Int = calc(3); on start { return; } }

script C version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Rat; ok: Bool; } enum K { A; B; } entity E { state r: R = R(ok = true, x = 1); state k: K = K::B; state o: Option<Rat> = Some(2); state n: Option<Int> = None; state a: Result<Int, Text> = Ok(4); state b: Result<Int, Text> = Err("bad"); on start { return; } }
script C version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } fn get(r: R) -> Int = r.x; entity E { state x: Int = get(R(x = 7)); on start { return; } }
script C version "1.0.0"; entity E { state v: Vec2 = vec2(1, 2) * 3; state safe: Bool = false and (1 / 0 > 0); on start { return; } }

negative.source: script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state dt: Rat = time.delta(); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state safe: Bool = false and (time.delta() > 0); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Rat = 1 / 0; on start { return; } }
